rationale: Trump suspends Russia sanctions weakening Western pressure during war; St Petersburg oil strike continues; EU tariffs hit Ukrainian steel exports; all affect Ukraine's war effort.

top_events.title: Trump says suspension of Russia sanctions is to keep peace negotiations going
top_events.label: Trump suspends Russia sanctions for peace talks
top_events.summary: US president blocked sanctions two days before effect. Weakens Western pressure on Russia during Ukraine war, major concern for Ukrainian defense.

top_events.title: Oil facilities hit in deadly overnight attack on St Petersburg

top_events.summary: At least one killed in strikes on Russian oil infrastructure and data center. Ukrainian operation continues targeting Russian war economy.

top_events.title: EU tariffs aimed at China hitting Ukraine, steel boss says
top_events.label: EU tariffs aimed China hitting Ukraine steel
top_events.summary: Ukrainian steel company boss says country bundled with China in EU import curbs. Damages wartime economy during critical period.
